The role is accountable for turning a complex cross-enterprise mandate into an executable roadmap, strong governance, transparent reporting and measurable outcomes.

· Own integrated delivery across discovery, planning, execution and transition to sustainable business-as-usual controls.
· Establish and run the program management office, including the integrated roadmap, and master schedule. Coordinate with regional delivery teams on their work breakdown structure, resource plan, financial controls and delivery standards.
· Design and operate program governance, including steering committee, governance committee and working-team forums, with clear decision rights, escalation paths and accountabilities.
· Lead multiple project managers, workstream leads, internal teams and external delivery partners. Set expectations, remove barriers and drive timely decisions.

· Ensure delivery evidence, controls and reporting are clear, traceable and suitable for senior management, audit and regulatory review.
· Manage vendors and systems integrators, including scope, deliverables, commercial performance, quality and knowledge transfer.

An established financial services organization within the insurance sector.

6. Experience leading federated programs where central standards and governance support execution by business or regional teams.
7. Working knowledge of structured and unstructured data environments, data lifecycle practices, classification, retention and disposition concepts.

jobs.description:
Job ID:
10365

Employment Type:
Existing Role

Work Environment:
We offer a hybrid work environment that offers flexibility to our employees in balancing in-office (2 days per week OR 15 hours per week in a Wawanesa office) and remote work. You may work from any of the following locations: Winnipeg, MB; Calgary, AB; oronto (North York), ON; Kitchener.

Working Business Language
: English

Salary:
At Wawanesa, salary is only one component of a holistic, comprehensive and competitive offering that we provide to our employees. In addition to salary, full-time and part-time permanent employees are eligible for an annual bonus plan, leave of absence top-up programs and provided with generous vacation time, personal days, premium free benefits and pension plan.

The salary offered for this role is determined with consideration to various factors, including but not limited to: your work location, local labour market conditions, external market salary data, internal pay equity and the knowledge, skills, experience and anticipated proficiency in the role. The salary offered is estimated to be within the following range: $120,000 - $140,000. Candidates with salary expectations outside of the range are still encouraged to apply.

About The Wawanesa Mutual Insurance Company

Founded in 1896, The Wawanesa Mutual Insurance Company is one of Canada’s largest mutual insurers, fully owned by its more than 1.8 million members. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Wawanesa is the parent company of WSI™, a specialty insurer delivering tailored solutions built around unique needs; Wawanesa Life, a provider of life insurance products; and Western Financial Group, a leading national distributor of personal and commercial insurance.

Wawanesa is committed to helping communities thrive in a changing world. The company invests more than $4 million annually in charitable initiatives, including $2.5 million each year to support people and communities on the front lines of climate change. Learn more at wawanesa.com.

We are currently seeking dedicated, driven, and enthusiastic individuals who thrive in a dynamic environment, embrace change, and are eager to gain diverse experience while advancing their careers as part of a growing team.

Job Overview

The Director, Personal Lines, Business Planning & Performance is responsible for coordinating business strategy and planning development, providing trusted advice, insights and performance management across the Personal lines of business and key business partners.

This role provides critical support to the SVP & Chief Personal Lines Officer by monitoring market developments and gathering internal and external performance metrics and business insights to enable informed decision-making, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring enterprise-level alignment in planning, reporting, and execution. This role also brings together pertinent information (performance metrics, business insights and market data) into a cohesive view and narrative for the Line of Business for Executive and Board reporting. With direct leadership of cross functional business planning and market monitoring, this role is instrumental in building a performance-focused and member-centric culture. This role requires balancing high-level strategic work with tactical execution, ensuring focus on achieving Wawanesa’s critical goals in the coming years.

Job Responsibilities

Serve as an advisor to the Chief Personal Lines Officer, delivering confidential counsel and perspective on matters of priority to Personal Lines planning and performance across the line of business.
Coordinate the Personal Lines strategic and tactical business planning process, gathering the relevant operational reporting/performance monitoring inputs, ensuring alignment with enterprise planning processes and priorities.
Collaborate closely with executive leadership to translate strategic objectives into measurable initiatives and performance indicators. Oversee the design and execution of executive reporting dashboards, business reviews, and decision-support analytics for the SVP and senior leadership.
Monitor and analyze external competitor and market developments, industry benchmarks, and risk, to present actionable information to support decision-making and prepare the organization to adapt effectively and proactively to changes.
Foster a collaborative environment that brings together sales, operations, finance, compliance, legal, and strategy to address performance and planning needs holistically.
Drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver results by executing through influence, effectively navigating a matrixed structure without direct authority.
Create and manage agendas and execute logistics for Personal Lines Senior Leadership meetings (including strategy and offsite sessions), Personal Lines communication forums (e.g., Townhalls, Ask Anything sessions, etc.) and track follow-ups.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, actuarial science, analytics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced education is an asset.
Minimum 8–10 years of experience in strategic or business planning, performance reporting, operational leadership or regulatory compliance in the P&C insurance industry.
Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams and delivering results in a matrixed environment.
Strong understanding of insurance operations, risk management and industry financial and non-financial performance drivers.
Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into action, drive execution, and measure impact through well-structured performance frameworks, including analyzing complex issues from multiple angles and provide sound counsel among competing priorities.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with a high degree of comfort working with data, financials, and reporting tools.
Exceptional versatility, agility, situational awareness, and composure. Proven ability to navigate multiple issues concurrently and prioritize critical work.
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues from multiple angles and provide sound counsel among competing priorities, including experience in financial literacy and quantitative analysis, with the ability to distill actionable insights.
Effective communicator and collaborator, with strong storytelling and presentation skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Deep alignment with Wawanesa’s values and purpose, with a passion for supporting people, protecting members, and improving the way we work.
Flexibility to travel within Canada and work variable hours, including overtime, as required.
Agile business mindset with a focus on innovative problem-solving and interdepartmental collaboration.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level correspondence.

Diversity Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Wawanesa, we are committed to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and believe that our strength lies in the diversity of our people – this is supported by having a representative workforce.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including racialized persons, women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender-diverse and neurodiverse individuals, and anyone who can contribute to the further diversification of thought and ideas.

We aim to ensure our recruitment process is accessible to all candidates. If you require accommodations during any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out in confidence to jobs@wawanesa.com.

All Wawanesa job applicants are subject to Wawanesa's Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:

As the executive technology leader for a global energy advisory firm of roughly 300 professionals across Europe and North America, you will hold complete accountability for the entire technical ecosystem. This pivotal role balances high-level commercial impact with a practical, hands-on approach, bridging internal corporate systems with sophisticated client-facing digital products. You will lead cross-border enterprise IT, oversee a distributed international team, direct managed services, and orchestrate modern AI and automation strategies to scale operations efficiently. Operating in an agile, business-first environment without heavy administrative friction, your technical vision and execution will directly shape company growth, vendor partnerships, and core client capabilities across multiple regions.

Accountabilities

Enterprise IT and operations across multiple countries, including network infrastructure, cybersecurity, endpoint management, global service desk, and identity and access management.
Internal business systems and reporting architecture, maintaining and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Finance & Operations, and associated data workflows.
Portfolio management of client-facing platforms in two regions, defining product roadmaps, ensuring system connectivity, and driving continuous platform maintenance.
AI and automation integration, collaborating directly with business units to optimize processes and deploy modern tools that drive growth without proportional headcount expansion.
Strategic technology cost management, managing global vendor relationships, licensing negotiations, and outsourced managed-service arrangements.
Leadership and mentorship of a distributed, multi-country technology team, fostering a high-performance culture across time zones.

Requirements

Proven track record leading technology strategy and execution within a mid-sized organization, encompassing both internal business systems and client-facing digital products.
Deep experience in the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 environments.
Hands-on operational leadership style, actively engaging with and building upon modern tools rather than solely delegating or overseeing high-level governance.
Strong commercial acumen with demonstrable success in vendor negotiations, licensing optimization, and multi-country technology budget management.
High adaptability and cross-cultural communication skills required to lead distributed teams and support operations across various time zones.
Pragmatic, business-first mindset suited for a lean, efficient environment that values speed and outcomes over heavy process or top-down IT governance.
Familiarity with modern data platform architecture (Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI), experience navigating corporate ownership transitions, or prior energy sector exposure is highly advantageous.

Benefits

Competitive executive salary package reflecting the impact and scale of the role.
Fully remote work model offering geographic and schedule flexibility.
Comprehensive healthcare and medical coverage plan.
Global business exposure and opportunities for professional leadership growth in a scaling, international energy advisory environment.
Direct access to executive decision-makers and key business stakeholders in a streamlined, low-bureaucracy organizational culture.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation is a critical enabler of Finance modernization and enterprise scale. This role owns the strategy, architecture, and execution of finance systems, integrations, and automation — ensuring that financial data, workflows, and insights flow seamlessly across the organization and franchise network.

As 1-800-GOT-JUNK? evolves toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will help shift Finance from manual processes to a connected, technology-enabled ecosystem. They will partner closely with Finance, Product, and Technology leaders to ensure financial systems evolve in lockstep with new products, pricing models, payment flows, and operating rhythms.

The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation combines financial process knowledge with systems thinking, technical fluency, and cross-functional leadership. They bring structure to complexity, simplify workflows, and ensure Finance technology supports better decisions — not just better reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Product, and the Field
. The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation enables Finance to move faster, think smarter, and scale confidently — automating the manual, simplifying the complex, and ensuring financial systems support the company’s next phase of growth.

Your Impact & What You'll Own

Finance Systems Strategy & Architecture: Own the end-to-end finance systems architecture, ensuring alignment across ERP, CRM, payments, FP&A, and BI platforms. Design scalable, resilient system landscapes that support growth, product expansion, and franchise complexity. Act as the enterprise steward of how financial data moves, connects, and is consumed.
Integration & Data Flow Enablement: Lead the design and delivery of system integrations using integration platforms and native APIs. Ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data flows between finance, product, and operational systems.Establish data governance principles that support a single source of truth and enterprise confidence in financial data.
Product & Technology Partnership: Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure finance systems support new products, pricing models, and customer journeys. Translate financial requirements into system capabilities early in the product lifecycle. Support experimentation and iteration while maintaining financial discipline and controls.
Leadership, Delivery & Governance: Lead and develop a high-performing team and vendor ecosystem. Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and drive delivery with accountability. Establish governance for finance systems changes, enhancements, and adoption.
Automation & Process Modernization: Lead the roadmap to automate and optimize core finance processes, including close, AR/AP, forecasting, and reporting. Reduce manual effort and operational risk by simplifying workflows and eliminating redundant processes. Ensure automation efforts balance efficiency, control, and business usability.
Franchise & Field Enablement: Collaborate with franchise partners and field teams to design integrations and tools that simplify their financial workflows. Ensure finance systems scale across the franchise network while respecting local realities and adoption needs. Act as a bridge between enterprise systems and on-the-ground execution.

What You Bring To The Table

8 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, systems architecture, financial technology, enterprise applications, or finance technology transformation, with a strong track record of building and scaling technology solutions.
Strong engineering and coding foundation — with hands-on experience in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and the ability to write, review, troubleshoot, and understand production code. Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, databases, data pipelines, and integration frameworks.
Advanced integration and data-flow expertise — proven ability to connect systems and make them work together across platforms, data warehouses, and SaaS applications using APIs, middleware, integration platforms, and custom solutions, while ensuring reliable, accurate, and traceable data flows.
Strong technical understanding of modern data and cloud architecture, including relational databases, SQL, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, event-driven integrations, and integration technologies. Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or similar is highly valued.
Systems thinker and problem solver who can look across the entire technology ecosystem, identify gaps and points of failure, and determine whether the right solution is configuration, integration, automation, or custom development.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building from the ground up — able to simplify complex problems, make pragmatic technology decisions, and create scalable solutions without over-engineering. Ability to work closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams and translate between business needs and technical solutions.
Builder mentality — curious, hands-on, and willing to get into the details. You don't just identify that two systems need to connect; you understand how they should connect and can work with engineers or vendors to make it happen.
Understanding of finance processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, month-end close, revenue and payments is an asset
Experience working with Netsuite or finance systems and applications is an asset

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $159,000 to $186,000 per annum (The actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience, and internal parity)
Health & Dental: The Total Compensation Package includes Extended Health and dental coverage.
Professional Growth: We focus on your development through our professional development programs.
Wellness: Enjoy a variety of health and wellness initiatives, including access to gym facilities at our corporate head office.
Transparency: Speak to us to learn more about the full details of what we offer.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Our Model: We have created a hybrid work model that helps us get together to Collaborate, Celebrate, and Connect while enjoying flexibility.
Office Presence: For this role’s duty and responsibility, we anticipate that you will come into the office three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday.

THE HIRING PROCESS

Pre-Screen: Let’s talk about your experience, goals, and excitement for this role.
Interviews: Our process is designed to be both engaging and transparent, as we know this is as big of a decision for you as it is for us.
Verification: We conduct reference and background checks as part of our final steps.
Modern Practices: We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices.

About Us

Award-Winning Culture: O2E Brands has been named one of Canada’s Best Workplaces 14 times.
Global Recognition: We made Newsweek’s top 100 list of “Most Loved Workplaces” at #14—the only Canadian company on the list!
Social Presence: Check out our culture on YouTube and social media to see what life is like here.
Inclusivity: We value diversity and inclusivity; accommodations are available upon request.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply today!

jobs.title: Leader, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026

This is a hybrid role with two days per week at Cisco’s Atlanta, Toronto or RTP offices. Alternate locations will be considered on an exception basis.

Members of the Finance organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet The Team

The Market Insights team delivers the market intelligence behind executive decision-making at Cisco. We size markets, track the competitive landscape, and analyze customer behavior to inform where Cisco invests, builds, and competes.

We’re a team of analysts, data scientists, engineers, and market intelligence leaders focused on the practical application of data to hard business problems. Using proprietary data and machine learning, we surface new market opportunities and flag risks early. Every insight we produce is built to be acted on, so that resource allocation and product roadmaps rest on objective evidence rather than assumption.

Your Impact

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll sit between our data architecture and the strategic decisions it informs. Working with experts from the team, you’ll build the analytical solutions and dashboards that support the market insight analysis in the team and help visualize to give executives clear understanding into market performance — sizing opportunities, measuring how we’re performing against them, and translating what the data says into recommendations leaders can act on.

Responsibilities

Market Analysis: Run deep-dive analyses across large, disparate datasets — internal telemetry, third-party analyst data, public financial disclosures — to identify trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities in the global technology market.
Market Sizing & Forecasting: Build and maintain TAM models and forecasts for priority segments, tracking forecast accuracy and refining methodology over time.
Visualization: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards that turn complex datasets into insight an executive can absorb in two minutes.
Gen AI Integration: Apply LLMs and agentic workflows to synthesize unstructured sources — analyst reports, earnings calls, customer feedback — and to accelerate recurring reporting and narrative development.
Data Modeling: Architect and optimize the data models behind our analytical platforms for accuracy, scalability, and performance, and continuously improve the collection and reporting workflows that feed them.
Stakeholder Partnership: Work with Sales, Product Management, and Strategy to turn open business questions into analytical work, and own the reporting cadence that supports their planning.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field — Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science — or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in business intelligence, data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
Hands-on experience with Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable visualization platform.
Strong grounding in data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Demonstrated experience applying LLMs to business problems — automating analysis, synthesizing unstructured data, or building agentic workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
Python or R for statistical analysis and automation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Contribute to the City of Hamilton, one of Canada’s largest cities - home to a diverse and strong economy, an active and inclusive community, a robust cultural and dining scene, hundreds of kilometers of hiking trails and natural beauty just minutes from the downtown core, and so much more. Join our diverse team of talented and ambitious staff who embody our values of sensational service, courageous change, steadfast integrity, collective ownership and being engaged empowered employees. Help us achieve our vision of being the best place to raise a child and age successfully. #BeTheReason

Job ID #32268: Director, Development Planning
Union: Non-Union
Job Description ID #: A13715
Close date: Interested applicants please submit your application online at www.hamilton.ca/city-council/jobs-cityby 4:00 p.m. on Wednesday October 21, 2026.
Vacancy type: This posting is for an existing vacancy
Internal applicants should apply with your work e-mail address. External applicants are considered only after the internal posting process has been completed. Only applicants chosen for an interview will be contacted.

DIRECTOR, DEVELOPMENT PLANNING

Summary Of Duties

Reporting to the Director of Planning and Chief Planner in the Planning Division, Planning and Economic Development Department, provides strategic leadership, through subordinate management, to a multi-functional workforce engaged in development review and development approvals.

The Director of Development Planning is one of the City’s foremost city-builders, responsible for a range of services and functions related to managing and ensuring the city’s sustainable growth and development.

The role requires both a strategic, long-term outlook, as well as an ability to meet the demands of a fast-paced environment related to development approvals.

Recommends broad policies and long-range strategies with respect to ensuring the efficiency of the City’s development review process and to meet mandated goals and objectives.

Accountable for establishing and achieving Divisional goals and objectives, as established by the Director of Planning and Chief Planner, through the effective and efficient use of financial and staff resources.

Uses a "best practices" approach in developing and delivering quality services in a timely and cost-effective manner. Instills a customer service focus within the Development Planning Section of the Planning Division.

Pursues continual improvements to ensure that the City’s development review process is timely and efficient.

Evaluates and reports on the Development Planning Section's service, financial, administrative and staff performance against internal and external benchmarks. Designs and implements strategies to improve effectiveness and efficiency. Sets above average standards and leads by example.

Acts and behaves to demonstrate a strong leadership and guidance, customer focus, innovation / creativity, team building / team advocacy, staff delegation, empowerment and staff development and are results oriented.

Is a member of the Planning Division Management Team, providing strategic direction for the Division as a whole.

Responsibilities

Ensure excellence in the quality of new development in the City of Hamilton.

You will assume lead accountability and responsibility for the Development Planning Section within the Planning Division

Develop goals and objectives and ensure delivery of development review and development approvals, including but not limited to Official Plan Amendments, zoning approvals, subdivision/condominium approvals, and part lot control.

Ensure compliance with Provincial and Federal statutes and regulations and Municipal by-laws and policies.

Assist the Director of Planning and Chief Planner in responding to various Corporate, community, Provincial or Federal proposals for service initiatives, changes or enhancements.

Assist the Planning Division and the Planning and Economic Development Department in delivering on the City’s climate change objectives.

Assist the Planning Division and the Planning and Economic Development Department in delivering on the City’s objectives with respect to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion.

Provide professional advice, including reports, to Council and its Committees.

Exercise delegated authorities for development approvals, as authorized by City Council, the General Manager of Planning and Economic Development, and the Director of Planning and Chief Planner.

Ensure cost effective delivery of services and provide regular tracking and reporting on revenues and budgets.

Provide leadership and support to staff, and implement engagement and recognition efforts, within the Development Planning Section.

The Director is accountable to the Director of Planning and Chief Planner for ensuring the development review and development approvals program is provided in accordance with City and Provincial guidelines and in the most effective and efficient manner consistent with the City of Hamilton’s and Department’s Mission, Vision and Values.

GENERAL DUTIES

Participate in strategic planning and direction of the Division as a member of the Division Management Team.

Provide coaching and advice to subordinate managers / supervisors to optimize performance.

Develop and monitor the annual Capital / Operating Budget for the Section.

Ensure compliance with Provincial and Federal statutes and regulations and Municipal by-laws and policies.

Respond to various Corporate, community, Provincial or Federal proposals for service initiatives, changes or enhancements.

Implement customer service improvement initiatives and create a customer-focused culture.

Effectively manage the approved financial and staffing resources of the Section.

Provide professional planning advice and consultation, including reports, to Council and its Committees, the business community and the public.

Establish and complete goals and objectives and initiate projects, including but not limited to those related to the following: community development, Official Plan Amendments, business facilitation, Development Review Team, Plan of Subdivision and Plan of Condominium approvals, Zoning By-law Amendments, Part-Lot Control, Cash-in-Lieu of Parking, Sign By-law Variances, Pits and Quarries, Committee of Adjustment application reviews, comments on Ministry of Environment (MOE) Permits, administration / review of Records of Site Condition, street addressing / street names, and preparation of information and educational materials related development processes.

Provides expert testimony to support the City’s position on planning issues at hearings of the Ontario Land Tribunal.

Attends public meetings and presents the city’s position/actions to the public, media and outside government bodies. Participates, and regularly acts as a public and media spokesperson for the work of the Section.

Direct and manage the general administration of the work areas in the Section by developing and recommending new policies and procedures and monitoring existing ones to maximize utilization of resources and improve customer service.

Establish criteria and priorities for annual work program and performance measures. Prepare work schedules, assign duties to staff, establish priorities, conduct staff hiring, monitor and evaluate staff performance, discipline and train staff, as well as assist in developing staff to their full potential.

Provide strong Corporate leadership by developing strategies to attract and retain more businesses, increase employment opportunities, and financially improve the City’s non-residential tax base.

Provide strategic advice and participate on numerous and various Corporate committees including chairing key committees to ensure financial growth, new development and to increase confidence in investment by the business community.

Highly developed analytical and business planning skills with a proven track record for long-term visioning and big picture thinking.

Highly effective leadership, facilitation, communication, interpersonal and organizational skills in a predominantly unionized environment.
Demonstrated mediation / dispute resolution and negotiation skills.
Demonstrated ability to effectively manage a large multi-disciplinary staff in a results-oriented environment and in a predominantly unionized environment. Knowledge of collective bargaining process.
Extensive experience in designing and delivering customer-focused programs and services.
Proven ability to deal effectively with elected officials, media, other levels of government, management, peers, staff and the general public.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
“Sales organizations tend have a certain reputation, and this one has charted a refreshingly different path: the bar for performance here is high, but so is the bar for how you clear it. Our people are capable and move with urgency, and they're also kind, generous, and usually three steps into solving a problem before anyone thinks to ask, a combination that is rarer than it should be. The outbound story at Absorb is still being written. This role is a rare chance to hold the pen.”-
Megan Bosch, VP Enterprise Sales

As the Director, Enterprise Sales at Absorb Software, you will be at the forefront of driving our growth by leading and managing the outbound sales process with prospective enterprise-level clients. This pivotal role requires a strategic thinker who excels in navigating complex relationships and executing a consultative sales approach.

Absorb Culture - Absorb LMS

What You’ll Do

Build and Lead: Form and guide a team of outbound Enterprise Sales Executives to achieve both individual and team quotas. Coach and enable the team to consistently build qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound prospecting, strategic networking, conference participation, and relationship-driven business development.
Mentor and Develop: Continuously mentor and develop the sales team through recruiting, coaching, and implementing corrective actions to maintain high performance.
Establish Relationships: Build lasting, consultative relationships with C-level executives in customer accounts.
Manage Performance: Oversee daily and weekly activities, pipelines, forecasts, and closed deals to ensure results exceed quotas through effective pipeline management.
Coordinate Reviews and Training: Lead weekly and monthly one-on-one and team-wide pipeline reviews, meetings, and training sessions to drive continuous improvement.
Drive New Business: Spearhead the acquisition of new logo accounts, focusing on key metrics such as Total New Bookings, Conversion Rate, and Average Deal Size.
Collaborate Globally: Work with regional and global leaders across various roles to maximize new logo bookings and meet or exceed KPIs.
Report to Leadership: Provide regular reports on sales activity and forecasts to the VP of Enterprise Sales.

What You’ll Bring

University or Bachelor’s degree, advanced university or Master’s degree preferred.
10 plus years of sales and 3+ years of sales management experience with a strong focus on outbound sales.
Industry Knowledge & Expertise: Understands market landscape, industry trends and has relationships with key influencers within the human resources software/e-learning industry.
People manager at heart: Proven ability to successfully hire and train new Sales/Account Executives while coaching lower performers to success
Demonstrated results in growing a business or expanding a market: a successful history of closing business and over-achieving quota as both an Enterprise seller and a leader.
Demonstrated ability to accurately forecast sales results.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Technologies We Use

Absorb LMS, Sales Navigator, Salesforce, SharePoint, Confluence, Zoom, Gong

Are you ready to become an Absorber?

What We Offer

Fully remote-first work with flexible work arrangements 🏡
Comprehensive Health and Wellness Benefits including retirement savings programs, eligibility for two different bonus plans, generous time off, comprehensive medical and dental benefits based on your country of location 🧘
New Hire Equipment Allowance and monthly Flex Allowance to support your success 📦
Endless opportunity for career growth and internal mobility 🌱
Employee driven DE&I programs 🫶

Who are we?

Absorb Software is the leading global AI-driven learning platform provider, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their workforce. With its innovative Strategic Learning Systems (SLS) approach, Absorb empowers businesses to align learning with strategic goals, driving measurable impact and workforce agility. The Absorb LMS platform delivers personalized, scalable, and engaging learning experiences for employees, customers, and partners worldwide. Trusted by over 3,300 organizations and 34 million users, Absorb is redefining the future of workplace learning through cutting-edge AI, seamless integrations, and an unwavering commitment to innovation. We empower learners to enrich their lives, workplaces and communities.

Our Values Are Simple

We achieve exceptional results by genuinely caring about each other and the work we do
We’re united, and we grow through our commitment to elevating continual learning!

AI @ Absorb

We believe in the power of AI and technology to make learning accessible to everyone. By exploring new tools and constantly experimenting, we’re redefining what’s possible. We take an AI‑first approach to unlock human potential, drive impact, and scale better outcomes. As the world evolves, Absorb is committed to growing with you. Investing in your skills every step of the way.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO
Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.
Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.
The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.
What you'll own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What year one looks like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.
How we work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.
Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.
What you get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.
If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.
We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology based in Canada.

As the executive technology leader for a global energy advisory firm of roughly 300 professionals across Europe and North America, you will hold complete accountability for the entire technical ecosystem. This pivotal role balances high-level commercial impact with a practical, hands-on approach, bridging internal corporate systems with sophisticated client-facing digital products. You will lead cross-border enterprise IT, oversee a distributed international team, direct managed services, and orchestrate modern AI and automation strategies to scale operations efficiently. Operating in an agile, business-first environment without heavy administrative friction, your technical vision and execution will directly shape company growth, vendor partnerships, and core client capabilities across multiple regions.

Accountabilities

Enterprise IT and operations across multiple countries, including network infrastructure, cybersecurity, endpoint management, global service desk, and identity and access management.
Internal business systems and reporting architecture, maintaining and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Finance & Operations, and associated data workflows.
Portfolio management of client-facing platforms in two regions, defining product roadmaps, ensuring system connectivity, and driving continuous platform maintenance.
AI and automation integration, collaborating directly with business units to optimize processes and deploy modern tools that drive growth without proportional headcount expansion.
Strategic technology cost management, managing global vendor relationships, licensing negotiations, and outsourced managed-service arrangements.
Leadership and mentorship of a distributed, multi-country technology team, fostering a high-performance culture across time zones.

Requirements

Proven track record leading technology strategy and execution within a mid-sized organization, encompassing both internal business systems and client-facing digital products.
Deep experience in the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 environments.
Hands-on operational leadership style, actively engaging with and building upon modern tools rather than solely delegating or overseeing high-level governance.
Strong commercial acumen with demonstrable success in vendor negotiations, licensing optimization, and multi-country technology budget management.
High adaptability and cross-cultural communication skills required to lead distributed teams and support operations across various time zones.
Pragmatic, business-first mindset suited for a lean, efficient environment that values speed and outcomes over heavy process or top-down IT governance.
Familiarity with modern data platform architecture (Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI), experience navigating corporate ownership transitions, or prior energy sector exposure is highly advantageous.

Benefits

Competitive executive salary package reflecting the impact and scale of the role.
Fully remote work model offering geographic and schedule flexibility.
Comprehensive healthcare and medical coverage plan.
Global business exposure and opportunities for professional leadership growth in a scaling, international energy advisory environment.
Direct access to executive decision-makers and key business stakeholders in a streamlined, low-bureaucracy organizational culture.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
